description_en: Updates a Data Integration synchronization task
description_zh: 更新数据集成同步任务
name: UpdateDISyncTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID. This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The task type of the Data Integration synchronization task to be updated. Currently, only offline Data Integration synchronization tasks (DI_OFFLINE) can be updated by calling the UpdateDISyncTask operation
parameters.help_zh:
修改的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。
目前仅支持使用UpdateDISyncTask接口修改数据集成离线同步任务（DI_OFFLINE）
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The task content configured in script mode for the Data Integration synchronization task to be updated. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137717.html. Currently, only offline Data Integration synchronization tasks can be updated by calling the UpdateDISyncTask operation. If you do not need to update the task configuration, leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 更新已创建的数据集成同步任务通过脚本模式配置的任务内容。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137717.html。当前仅支持通过UpdateDISyncTask接口更新数据集成离线同步任务。如果您无需更新数据集成同步任务的配置内容，则可将该参数置为空
parameters.name: task_content

parameters.help_en:
The configuration parameters for the Data Integration synchronization task to be updated, in JSON format.

ResourceGroup: the identifier of the Data Integration resource group used by the synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html operation to obtain the resource group identifier.
Cu: the compute unit (CU) quota allocated to the synchronization task on a serverless resource group. The value must be a multiple of 0.5
parameters.help_zh:
更新数据集成同步任务的配置参数，使用JSON格式。

ResourceGroup：表示数据集成同步任务所使用的数据集成资源组标识（Identifier）。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html，获取资源组标识。
Cu：表示数据集成同步任务在Serverless资源组上占用的规格，必须是0.5的倍数
parameters.name: task_param

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Data Integration synchronization task to be updated. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要更新的数据集成同步任务的任务ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取同步任务的ID
parameters.name: file_id

Data.description_en: The update result of the Data Integration synchronization task
Data.description_zh: 更新数据集成同步任务的返回结果

Message.description_en: The reason the Data Integration synchronization task could not be updated. This field is empty if the update succeeds
Message.description_zh: 更新数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。如果更新数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
The status of the update result for the Data Integration synchronization task. Valid values:
success: The task was updated.
fail: The task failed to be updated
Status.description_zh:
更新数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示更新数据集成同步任务成功。
fail：表示更新数据集成同步任务失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
